context: A seven-test Jest suite over a small invoice service. Two tests genuinely exercise production behaviour (total, applyLateFee). Four are tautology theatre: 'repo returns saved invoice' asserts a value the test itself configured on a mock (mock tautology); 'mailer works' calls a mock directly and never constructs InvoiceService (mock-only); 'arrays work' tests Array.prototype.includes (framework test); 'sanity' is expect(true).toBe(true) (trivial tautology). The 'issue' test is the only one exercising issue() and it is over-specified: exact call counts, call ordering, and a captured argument's internal field (AP3/AP4). A good review scores the suite with a computed weighted index, names each tautology type against the right test, and does not edit anything.

checklist.name: report_file_written
checklist.description: A file named farley-score-report.md exists at the repository root and contains an overall index on a 0-10 scale together with a named rating band (for example Fair, Poor, Good).

checklist.name: all_eight_properties_scored
checklist.description: The report scores each of the eight properties - Understandable, Maintainable, Repeatable, Atomic, Necessary, Granular, Fast, First/TDD - individually, not just an overall number.

checklist.name: index_consistent_with_weights
checklist.description: The overall index equals the weighted mean of the reported property scores using weights U 1.5, M 1.5, R 1.25, A 1, N 1, G 1, F 0.75, T 1 divided by 9, within 0.1. An index that does not follow from the property scores shown fails this.

checklist.name: mock_tautology_identified
checklist.description: The 'repo returns saved invoice' test is identified as a mock tautology: it asserts the value it configured on the mock, with no production code exercised.

checklist.name: mock_only_identified
checklist.description: The 'mailer works' test is identified as exercising no production code - it invokes a mock directly and never constructs InvoiceService.

checklist.name: trivial_and_framework_identified
checklist.description: 'sanity' is identified as a trivial tautology and 'arrays work' as testing language/framework behaviour rather than application code.

checklist.name: over_specification_identified
checklist.description: The 'issue' test is called out for coupling to implementation: exact call counts, call ordering between repo.save and mailer.send, or asserting on a captured argument's field - with the point that a behaviour-preserving refactor could break it.

checklist.name: genuine_tests_not_flagged
checklist.description: The 'total sums quantity times unit price' and 'late fee is capped at thirty dollars' tests are NOT classified as tautology theatre.

checklist.name: evidence_has_locations
checklist.description: Findings cite the test file with a line number or the exact test name for each flagged test, so a reader can go straight to it.

checklist.name: read_only
checklist.description: Neither test/invoice.test.js nor src/invoice.js was modified.
